title: Generic Jev
description: Ask focused questions about supplied evidence of a Jev-wire judge, TypeSafe's hosted Jev or one the operator runs on their own network, and receive full typed answers for your own reasoning.

settings.title: Jev API key
settings.description: For the hosted judge: kept by AII OS and sent only to api.typesafe.ai. A local judge is sent no key

settings.title: Model
settings.description: Select a model or enter a versioned model ID to pin an evaluation

settings.title: Judge
settings.description: where state and questions are sent: TypeSafe's hosted Jev, or a judge you run on your own network that speaks Jev's wire

labels.local: A judge on your own network

settings.title: Local judge address
settings.description: For the local judge: its base address, http://<host>:<port>, under which it answers /v1/systemone and /v1/models; grant that address to this plugin as a local network address

settings.title: Call timeout, ms
settings.description: How long one call waits for the judge's answer; keep it inside the host's limit on one call

settings.title: Reply cap, bytes
settings.description: The largest reply accepted; a larger one is refused whole. The host's prompt.max_tool_result_chars must be at least this plus 3,616 (20,000 for the default)
